scope: Structural lineage from a decisive assessment and result to a current passed test, implementation, and each requirement of the same criterion
false_green_before_fix: A synthetic field assessment with verdict cumplido passed validate although its result linked only baseline and criterion, with no path to a test or implementation.
post_fix_controls: cumplido and incumplido require a current passed test in the result ancestry for the same criterion and an implementation of every criterion requirement
a test of another requirement does not satisfy the criterion requirement
an absent test blocks a decisive verdict
a criterion with multiple requirements needs coverage of each requirement
revising a linked test or implementation invalidates the result and removes validate acceptance until current versions are linked and reviewed
no_demostrado remains available when the intervention cannot be substantiated
